prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create 10 separate square PNG icons that form ONE consistent set for a figure in a scientific paper. Make one image_gen call per icon.
Style for every icon: clean flat vector illustration, uniform thin dark-grey outlines, soft pastel fills with the accent colour as the main hue, at most one lighter tint for highlights, no gradients, no drop shadows, no texture.
Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, square 1024x1024 canvas, the subject centred with about 12% empty margin on every side, readable as a silhouette at 8 mm wide. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI chrome, borders or frames anywhere in the image.
Image 1 (tools.png) is a STYLE REFERENCE from the same figure set, not an edit target: match its character design, outline weight, fill treatment and margin.
Image 2 (context.png) is a STYLE REFERENCE from the same figure set, not an edit target: match its character design, outline weight, fill treatment and margin.
Icons:
(1) model.png: NO robot and NO character of any kind: a pretrained neural network drawn as a rounded square block containing three columns of small round nodes joined by thin lines (a layered network), the whole block sealed inside a translucent pale icy-blue ice cube with a small snowflake on the cube's corner, meaning a model whose weights are frozen, accent colour #8F98A4.
(2) f_c1.png: FILE ICON FAMILY (identical page in every f_ icon): an upright white document page with a folded top-right corner and three short grey text lines, plus one round badge overlapping its lower-right corner; this badge shows a small speech bubble with a gear inside, meaning a system prompt, accent colour #5A8BCB.
(3) f_c2.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a small shield with a check mark, meaning guardrails, accent colour #5A8BCB.
(4) f_c3.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a small bookmark ribbon over a stack of two cards, meaning long-term memory, accent colour #5A8BCB.
(5) f_c6.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a small lightning bolt, meaning an invokable skill, accent colour #5A8BCB.
(6) f_c8.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a small puzzle piece, meaning a plugin, accent colour #8C6CC8.
(7) f_c4.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a small wrench, meaning tool guidance, accent colour #5E9E62.
(8) f_c7.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a small terminal prompt symbol (an angle bracket and an underscore drawn as shapes, not letters), meaning an executable script, accent colour #5E9E62.
(9) f_c5.png: the same file icon page; its badge shows a tiny simple robot head, meaning a subagent definition, accent colour #C27896.
(10) f_out.png: the same file icon page but taller, with a dotted winding path line on the page ending in a small flag, and a badge showing a check mark, meaning an agent trajectory and its final deliverable, accent colour #6B7480.
Copy each final image into the current directory with exactly those file names, overwrite nothing else, do not edit the images afterwards, then list the directory.
